name: company-brain-harness
description: Portable Company Brain harness skills and CLIs for filesystem-backed knowledge roots.

interface.shortDescription: Connect, stage, approve, and score a company brain.
interface.longDescription: Portable role-based workflows and helper CLIs for starting, operating, and maintaining a company brain on any filesystem-backed root, with privacy-safe capture, staged promotion, health checks, onboarding, meeting intake, and repo-aware POC guardrails.
defaultPrompt: Use $brain-start to help a new user set up or operate a company brain.
Use $brain-owner to guide owner approvals and setup decisions.
Use $brain-operator to run today's brain check.
Use $brain-contribute to help a teammate add knowledge.
Use $brain-setup to scaffold a new company brain.
Use $brain-health to check this company brain.
Use $sources-check to validate org-wide source instances.
Use $brain-schedule to create the operating schedule.
Use $brain-lint to inspect freshness and provenance.
